name: get_service_backup_details
description: Returns one backup of a ClickHouse service: its status, start and finish times, size in bytes, duration in seconds, type, and, when the backup was exported to a customer bucket, its name and bucket details. Use list_service_backups to find backup ids. On failure result is an error object with status "error" and a message.

backupId.description: Backup to retrieve. Use the id of a backup returned by list_service_backups for the same service.

organizationId.description: Organization that owns the service. Use the id of an organization returned by get_organizations.

serviceId.description: ClickHouse service the backup belongs to. Use the id of a clickhouse-type service returned by get_services_list.
